title: 第二十一 章   追击厌火
content_zh:
一股尘土暴激，巨猿落到了招摇山上，萨满的法阵之中。手脚并用，周围的萨满们被捶的东倒西歪，将现场搅的天昏地暗。

    这些小虾米根本消不去巨猿心中的怒火。

    就在他锤杀城隍后，他心境一阵清明，察觉到自己中了阿娇儒萨满的暗算，阿娇儒在与他谈话的时候，给他悄悄地种下了心魔。

    他原本是肯定不会在这件事上出手，在夏人的地盘全力以赴地出手，风险实在太大，暴露自己后，就只能退回西荒，从而无法完成这次的任务。

    可阿娇儒萨满却用这种下三滥的手段，让自己完全暴露。

    一阵蓝色的能量波动在巨猿的脚下流动，将准备踩下的右脚拦住。

    “大将军，我们都是为了帝君的大业，何必生这么大的气呢。”阿娇儒萨满那独有的声音，从巨猿脚下传了出来。

    “阿娇儒。”巨猿加大力量，一脚将屏障踩破。

    阿娇儒的萨满的声音又从别处传来。

    “夏人援兵已到，在下先行撤退，知道将军神勇，必能灭杀夏人。我等在西荒等待将军凯旋。”

    空气中，光柱突起，彩光流动，瞬息之间场中所有的萨满，都被传送到一处山洞中。山洞中刻满了与外面一样的符号，萨满们找好自己的位置坐下，开始施法。

    一名萨满突然大惊失色地叫到：“阿娇儒，鸀鸟失去联系。”

    原本站在旁边的阿娇儒萨满，如鬼魅一般的突然出现在那名萨满旁边，将手按在他脑门上。

    哪怕阿娇儒萨满高深莫测的法力，也只能感到鸀鸟的存在，却无法像以前一样，进入它的意识里。

    “怎么会这样？”现场所有人心中都充满了疑问。

    看到场中的萨满全部消失，巨猿憋得一肚子火无从发泄，而且越烧越烈。阿娇儒萨满说的没错，现在他的状态，肯定已经引起了夏人的注意，现在赶快撤离才是最好的选择。

    “大.大哥”刚跑上来酒糟鼻，指着前方的阴影出。

    一排黑衣人，手挽手连在一起，在黑暗中若隐若现，时有时无。

    到了巨猿这样级别，已经不用依靠五官来观察的变化，周围细微元气的变动，他都可以察觉到，可这不过六尺的距离，他居然完全没感觉到。

    “对方很强。”巨猿细数了一下黑衣人的数量，一共八人。

    心生警觉的巨猿一下子想到什么，暗道一声不好，回过头去发现身后同样站着，一模一样的黑衣人。

    “夜游神！夏人的夜游神！”

    夜游神的可怕，不是因为他多强，而是因为他多烦。

    如影随形，阴魂不散，黏吝缴绕，所有的词语加起来，也无法解释夜游神的难缠。

    “吼吼吼”

    一声声巨吼在山野间回荡，其余四人化为巨兽。

    犬，野猪，蜈蚣，白蛇一字排开。

    白猿手脚并用，猛冲过去，后面紧跟着四兽。

    本来站在后面的夜游神，突然出现在前方。他们之间相互挽起手，随着元气流动的方向，上下漂浮，犹如浮萍。
content_en:
There was a burst of dust, and the giant ape fell into the shaman's circle on Zhaoyao Mountain. Using their hands and feet, the surrounding shamans were beaten and staggered, making the scene dark and dark.

    These little shrimps couldn't quell the anger in the giant ape's heart.

    Just after he killed the city god, his mind became clear for a while, and he realized that he had been plotted by the shaman A Jiao Ru. While talking to him, A Jiao Ru secretly planted inner demons in him.

    He was definitely not going to take action in this matter. The risk of going all out to take action in the Xia people's territory was too great. After exposing himself, he would have no choice but to retreat to the Western Wilderness, thus unable to complete this mission.

    But Gillian Shaman used such despicable methods to completely expose himself.

    A wave of blue energy flowed under the giant ape's feet, blocking the right foot that was about to step down.

    "General, we are all for the great cause of the emperor, why are we so angry?" The unique voice of Ajiao Ru Shaman came from the feet of the giant ape.

    "Ajiaoru." The giant ape increased his strength and trampled the barrier with one kick.

    Gillian's shaman's voice came from elsewhere.

    "The Xia people's reinforcements have arrived. I will retreat first. I know that the general is brave and will surely kill the Xia people. I will wait for the general's triumphant return in the Western Wilderness."

    In the air, light pillars protruded and colored lights flowed. In an instant, all the shamans in the field were teleported to a cave. The cave was filled with the same symbols as those outside. The shamans found their seats, sat down, and began to cast spells.

    A shaman suddenly shouted in fright: "Ajiaoru, the owl has lost contact."

    The Gillian shaman who was standing next to him suddenly appeared next to the shaman like a ghost and put his hand on his forehead.

    Even with the inscrutable magic power of Ajiaoru Shaman, he could only feel the presence of the owl, but could not enter its consciousness like before.

    "How could this happen?" Everyone present was filled with questions.

    Seeing that all the shamans in the field had disappeared, the giant ape was so filled with fire that he could not vent it, and the fire became more and more intense. Ajiaoru Shaman was right. His current state must have attracted the attention of the Xia people. The best choice is to evacuate quickly now.

    "Big Brother" just ran up to Rosacea and pointed at the shadow in front of him.

    A row of people in black, linked arm in arm, looming in and out of sight in the darkness.

    When he reached the level of a giant ape, he no longer needed to rely on his five senses to observe changes. He could detect subtle changes in vitality around him, but from a distance of only six feet, he actually didn't feel it at all.

    "The opponent is very strong." The giant ape counted the number of men in black, there were eight in total.

    The alert giant ape suddenly thought of something and secretly said something bad. He turned around and found the same man in black standing behind him.

    "The Night God! The Night God of the Xia people!"

    The Night Walker is scary not because of how strong he is, but because of how annoying he is.

    Like a shadow, lingering ghost, lingering around, all the words combined cannot explain the difficulty of the night wandering god.

    "Ho ho ho"

    A loud roar echoed in the mountains and fields, and the remaining four people turned into giant beasts.

    Dogs, wild boars, centipedes, and white snakes are lined up.

    The white ape used his hands and feet to rush forward, followed closely by the four beasts.

    The Night Traveler who was originally standing at the back suddenly appeared in front. They held hands with each other and floated up and down according to the direction of the flow of vitality, like duckweeds.
